content.title: Sloan Hooks on Instagram: "Welp that’s it! MANON is out 😢 #katseye #manon"
content.text: I'm pretty sure manon just dipped out of practice and gigs, she gives me that vibe. they probably cut her lose. Ultimately it is a jobSo I don't think a lot of people realize this was her idea.She doesn't want to return to the group.She left the group months ago and the label is begging her.They're trying to do everything they can to bring her back to the group , but she doesn't want to😂😂😂😂 if you're a fan you saw this coming months ago with all the last interview, she did where she talked about how she would lie to get out of rehearsals.So she didn't have to do them with the group or how she would pretend to be sick.So she had to do no promotion with the group , and the girls were looking at her and were like you shouldn't be saying this 😂😂😂 they even try to help her cover it, but she was like no.This is what I do 😂😂😂😂 you've also seen the countless interviews where she talks about how she hates the American work ethic, and she doesn't like the K-Pop standard scheduling.She just doesn't want to be in the group and that's fine.People need a let her go in peace.Why force her to be submerged?She doesn't want to be where she's not happy. And for those who wanna say no , she was kicked out and she wasn't otherwise the company would be suing her , just like they're doing with another member from another group that they actually kicked out because she said , hey , i'm still in the group , and the company said , no , you're not 😂😂 and then they hit her with a lawsuit 😂😂 but with her they're like, Hey, we really want you to come back, please.And she's like , no , and with the negotiations she says she's had with the label and it looking good for her.I guarantee you.She's gonna have a solo dealManon was always absent. Even in the documentary she never went to rehearsals. The others always should up no matter what. I think its for the best.just sent you something worth seeing Sloan👌@moist_measure yes but lara is just sri lankan and indian. And this guy is basically saying she's darker than manon = must have african originsAt the end of the day cats eye is one by a company that was primarily working with K-pop groups and the way they treat idols in that industry has never been good. I am disappointed but not surprised.I don't think it"s because she is black, they literally scouted her.While auditioning other contestants constanty complained about knowing that she was already chosenlets be honest hybe is just trash both heeseung and manon are forced out of their groups for no reason 👎 im no longer supporting hybe and just pirarting everythingIm sorry but is this (or could be) about race? I mean Lara has a similar skin color to her why is she getting mistreated for being black? I could be wrong bc I’m not there or anything of the sort, I could be just naive but I don’t think it could be bc of race… if someone has more info you can correct me.I would have left as well that group is assAll the girls in DA knows this will going to happen to Manon in the future 😂 putting the group in this position ughhThe way I literally knew from the beginning they were gonna kick out their black member
